[[Jung Zeng]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for items.

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Shenzun Tunnels}}, just outside Maatu Keep.

==Dialogue==
:''"The [[Jade Brotherhood]] may make themselves out to be noble, but that does not change the fact that they are nothing more than a gang of murderers and thieves. We of the [[Obsidian Flame (guild)|Obsidian Flame]] have always worked for the good of [[Cantha]], and we believe that the Jade Brotherhood must be destroyed before they can do more harm to the innocent citizens of [[Kaineng City]]. If you wish to prove yourself a friend of Cantha and the Obsidian Flame, hunt down the Jade Brotherhood and return to me with 5 [[Jade Bracelet]]s. I will give you this in return:''
